description:
Claim a unique username for the authenticated user's Public page. Usernames must be 3-30 characters, alphanumeric and underscores only.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account, signed in: call start_login, show the user its challenge, then wait_for_login, then call this tool again. Authenticating this client alone does NOT open this tool.

profile_id.description: The sub-account the username is for (its `id` from list_sub_accounts). Omitted: the primary sub-account.

username.description: Username to claim (3-30 chars, alphanumeric and underscores)

name: claim_username
